exposure: method of second-trimester abortion (medical vs. surgical)
cohort: Women who had second-trimester abortions between 12+0 and 24+0 weeks and subsequently had documented pregnancies within 3-60 months were included.
finding: Medical second-trimester abortion was associated with a higher incidence of placenta-associated pregnancy complications in subsequent pregnancies compared to surgical abortion.
gest_age: Second-trimester abortions between 12+0 and 24+0 weeks gestation.
